extra-663becaeb70f.zh-Hans: 创作一个可爱的日本女高中生平凡校园一天的Vlog风格个人家庭录像，由同班好友拍摄。超写实。由约10个短镜头（每个2～3秒）的硬切蒙太奇构成。每个镜头都是不同的地点、不同的瞬间，1个镜头＝1个小事件。不使用转场效果或淡入淡出。拍摄者是最要好的好友，所以她完全放松，对着镜头笑、展示东西、说话（听不清话语）。不是摆姿势或表演，而是只给好友看的真实表情。 主要被摄对象 所有镜头中都是同一个日本女高中生。不是引人注目的完美美人，而是笑起来瞬间最可爱、容易搭话、有亲切感的长相。 真实的皮肤质感，素颜，脸颊微微泛红。笑起来眼睛弯成月牙，露出一点虎牙。 黑色松软波波头，右耳上方用一枚小银发夹固定。 白色短袖开领衬衫、酒红色领结、灰色及膝百褶裙、白袜子、室内鞋（校外为白色运动鞋）、单肩书包。 脸、体型、发型、制服、随身物品从头到尾完全一致。 地点 夏季从早晨到傍晚的、极其普通的公立高中。鞋柜区、有窗边座位的教室、走廊、小卖部、中庭、放学后夕阳照射的教室、校门。有生活气息的真实学校。其他学生以自然程度出现在背景中。没有广告、可识别的品牌。 摄影机／视觉风格 所有镜头共通：好友手持的老式民用数码相机。自然的晃动、不完美的构图、偶尔的自动对焦变化、曝光波动、柔和的图像细节、轻微的运动模糊、微妙的数码噪点、略微偏低的色彩、不完美的白平衡。没有防抖、稳定器、无人机、慢动作、电影式照明、商业调色。 镜头列表（按顺序，每个2～3秒，全部硬切） 1. 课间休息。反坐在前排椅子上，用手势说着什么（听不见）。 2. 在小卖部买两个面包，把其中一个递向镜头。 3. 午休时中庭的长椅。一边啃面包，一边在树影斑驳的阳光中眯起眼睛。 4. 在走廊笑得太厉害，靠在墙上，用手指擦眼角。 5. 打扫时间。拿着扫帚做搞怪姿势，察觉到走廊尽头有人，慌忙认真地扫起来。 6. 在水龙头洗手，用湿指尖假装向镜头弹水珠，然后笑。 7. 放学后夕阳下的教室。趴在桌上打盹时被拍到，醒来后害羞地笑。 8. 在黑板角落画小涂鸦，回头露出虎牙咧嘴一笑，然后马上擦掉。 9. 在鞋柜区换运动鞋时，说着什么笑。 10. 在晚霞中的校门回头，双手大幅挥手。中途录像突然切黑。没有淡出。 物理真实感 所有镜头都保持可信的现实世界物理。手、手指、脚、制服、头发、面包、扫帚、笔记本、书包都自然运动。没有多余的手指、融合的手、重复的肢体、扭曲的解剖结构、漂浮物、消失的物体、突然变形。脚始终适当地与地板和地面接触。镜头之间保持被摄对象一致，光线从早晨→白天→晚霞自然推进。 音频 只有自然的环境音。每个镜头的环境音也切换。远处的铃声、室内鞋的声音、教室的嘈杂声、小卖部的喧闹、蝉鸣、扫帚声、远处社团活动的喊声、听不清具体话语的说话声和笑声。没有音乐。没有旁白。没有人工音效。 最终氛围 只是排列了12个不经意的瞬间，但事后回看会觉得很感动的影像。不是商业作品。不是时尚电影。不是音乐视频。只留在同班好友相机里的、平凡却再也回不去的校园一天的记录。天真无邪、青春进行中、怀旧、温暖、即兴、极具人情味。优先营造摄影机恰好在那里的感觉。
extra-663becaeb70f.en: Create a cute Japanese high school girl's ordinary school day as a Vlog-style personal home video shot by her best friend in the same class. Hyper-realistic. Composed as a hard-cut montage of about 10 short shots (2–3 seconds each). Each shot is in a different place and a different moment, one shot = one small event. No transition effects or fades. The person filming is her closest best friend, so she is completely relaxed, smiles at the camera, shows things, and talks to it (words are unintelligible). Not poses or acting, but the raw expressions she shows only to her best friend. Main subject: the same Japanese high school girl throughout all shots. Not a striking perfect beauty, but a friendly, approachable face that is cutest at the moment she laughs. Realistic skin texture, no makeup, a slight redness on the cheeks. When she laughs her eyes become crescent moons and a snaggletooth peeks out slightly. Black hair in a loose bob, pinned above her right ear with a small silver hairpin. White short-sleeved open-collar shirt, maroon ribbon, gray knee-length pleated skirt, white socks, indoor shoes (white sneakers outside school), shoulder-strap school bag. Keep face, body type, hairstyle, uniform, and belongings completely consistent from start to finish. Locations: an ordinary public high school from a summer morning to evening. Entrance hall, classroom with window-side seats, hallway, school store, courtyard, classroom bathed in after-school sunset, school gate. A real school with a lived-in feel. Other students at a natural level in the background. No ads, no recognizable brands. Camera / visual style common to all shots: a handheld old consumer digital camera held by the best friend. Natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, exposure fluctuations, soft image detail, slight motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly muted colors, imperfect white balance. No stabilization, gimbal, drone, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading. Shot list (in order, 2–3 seconds each, all hard cuts): 1. Break time. Sitting backwards on the chair of the seat in front, gesturing and saying something (unintelligible). 2. Buying two breads at the school store, holding one out to the lens. 3. Lunch break on a courtyard bench. Squinting in the dappled sunlight while biting into bread. 4. In the hallway, laughing too much and leaning against the wall, wiping the corner of her eye with a finger. 5. Cleaning time. Holding a broom, striking a goofy pose, noticing a presence down the hallway, and hurriedly starting to sweep seriously. 6. Washing hands at the tap, pretending to flick water droplets at the camera with wet fingertips and laughing. 7. After school, classroom in the sunset. Filmed while she is napping with her head on the desk, wakes up and gives an embarrassed laugh. 8. Drawing a small doodle in the corner of the blackboard, turning around, grinning with her snaggletooth showing, and quickly erasing it. 9. At the entrance hall, changing into sneakers while saying something and laughing. 10. At the school gate in the sunset glow, turning around and waving big with both hands. Midway, the recording suddenly cuts to black. No fade-out. Physical realism: maintain believable real-world physics in all shots. Hands, fingers, feet, uniform, hair, bread, broom, notebook, school bag behave naturally. No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating objects, disappearing objects, or sudden deformation. Feet stay properly connected to the floor and ground. Keep the subject consistent between shots, and light progresses naturally from morning → noon → sunset. Audio: natural ambient sound only. Ambient sound also switches per shot. Distant chimes, indoor-shoe footsteps, classroom chatter, school-store bustle, cicadas, broom sounds, distant club-activity shouts, unintelligible speech and laughter. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Final mood: a video that is just 12 casual moments lined up, yet feels nostalgic when watched later. Not a commercial work. Not a fashion film. Not a music video. A record of an ordinary, never-to-return school day that remains only on the camera of a best friend in the same class. Innocent, mid-youth, nostalgic, warm, improvised, deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.
